q1.explanationZh: be 是系动词“是”，现在时有 am、is、are 三种形式。

q2.explanationZh: beach 名词“海滩”，on the beach“在海滩上”。

q4.explanationZh: bear 作动词“忍受；承受”（过去式 bore），作名词是“熊”，两个同形词拼写相同。

q5.explanationZh: beard 名词“胡须”，注意拼写 b-e-a-r-d。

q6.explanationZh: beast 名词“野兽”，the king of all beasts“百兽之王”。

q7.explanationZh: beat 可作及物动词“打；打败”、不及物动词“（心脏）跳动”和名词“节拍”，过去式 beat。

q8.explanationZh: beauty 去 y 变 i 加 -ful 构成形容词 beautiful“美丽的”。

q9.explanationZh: beauty 名词“美丽；美人”，形容词是 beautiful。

q10.explanationZh: because 是连词“因为”，引导原因状语从句；because of 后接名词。

q11.explanationZh: become“变成”，过去式 became，过去分词 become。

q12.explanationZh: bed 名词“床”，也可指河床、湖底或海底。

q13.explanationZh: bed + room 构成合成词 bedroom“卧室”。

q14.explanationZh: bed + time 构成 bedtime“就寝时间”，也可作形容词，如 a bedtime story。

q15.explanationZh: bee 名词“蜜蜂”，复数 bees。

q16.explanationZh: beef“牛肉”是不可数名词，some beef“一些牛肉”。

q17.explanationZh: beer“啤酒”，a barrel of beer“一桶啤酒”。

q18.explanationZh: before 可作介词或连词“在……之前”，Look before you leap.“三思而后行。”

q19.explanationZh: beg“乞求，恳求”，现在分词双写 g：begging，过去式 begged。

q20.explanationZh: beg 双写 g 加 -ar 构成名词 beggar“乞丐”。

q21.explanationZh: begin“开始”，过去式 began，过去分词 begun。

q22.explanationZh: behalf 名词“利益；方面”，常用 on behalf of“代表……”。

q23.explanationZh: behave 不及物动词“表现；举止端正”，behave oneself“举止规矩”。

q24.explanationZh: behave 的名词形式 behaviour“行为”，英式拼写 behaviour，美式拼写 behavior。

q25.explanationZh: behind 作介词“在……背后”，作副词“在后面”。

q26.explanationZh: being 名词“存在；人；生物”，human being“人类”。

q27.explanationZh: belief 是 believe 的名词形式“信念”，复数是 beliefs，不是 believes。

q28.explanationZh: believe 动词“相信；认为”，名词是 belief。

q29.explanationZh: bell 名词“铃；钟”，注意双写 l。

q30.explanationZh: belong 不及物动词，表示“属于”时用 belong to，不用于进行时和被动语态。

q31.explanationZh: be born in“出生于”，born 是 bear“生育”的过去分词。

q32.explanationZh: bear ... in mind“记住……”，宾语较长时常放在 in mind 后面：bear in mind what...。

q35.explanationZh: believe in“信任；相信……的存在或价值”，不同于 believe sb.“相信某人说的话”。

q36.explanationZh: take a beating“受到打击”，beating 是 beat 的名词形式。

q37.explanationZh: belong to“属于”，to 是介词，后接名词或代词。

q38.explanationZh: beg (for) sth. from/of sb.“向某人乞讨某物”，for 可省略，介词 from 或 of 都可以。

q39.explanationZh: beg a favour of sb.“请某人帮忙”，favour 是英式拼写，美式拼写 favor。

q40.explanationZh: beg sb. to do sth.“请求某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q41.explanationZh: begin at“从……开始”，多指从某一点、某一时刻开始。

q42.explanationZh: begin with“由……开始”；to begin with 是“首先，第一”。

q43.explanationZh: believe it or not“信不信由你”，常放在句首。

q44.explanationZh: behave oneself“举止规矩”，behave 作及物动词时宾语用反身代词。

q45.explanationZh: on behalf of“代表……；为了……的利益”。

q46.explanationZh: “站在你身后的男孩”，behind 作介词“在……后面”。

q47.explanationZh: 情态动词 would 后用动词原形，“方案何时开始”用 begin。

q48.explanationZh: 名词 house 前需要形容词，“美丽的新房子”用 beautiful。

q49.explanationZh: have a picnic on the beach“在海滩上野餐”。

q50.explanationZh: to the best of my belief“据我确信”，my 后需要名词 belief。

q51.explanationZh: believe in“相信……的价值”，主语 people 是复数，用原形 believe。

q52.explanationZh: 谚语 Look before you leap.“三思而后行”，before 意为“在……之前”。

q53.explanationZh: “被蜜蜂蛰过”，泛指蜜蜂用复数 bees。

q54.explanationZh: belong to“属于”，doesn’t 后用动词原形 belong。

q55.explanationZh: the 后需要名词，the beauty of life“生活之美”。

q56.sampleAnswer: Students are expected to bear in mind what teachers say in class.
references: Students are expected to bear in mind what teachers say in class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q56.explanationZh: “应该”可用 be expected to；“记住”= bear in mind，宾语从句 what teachers say 较长，放在 in mind 后面。

q57.sampleAnswer: The surgeon immediately devoted himself to the next operation before he could take a good rest.
references: The surgeon immediately devoted himself to the next operation before he could take a good rest.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “还没来得及……就……”可用 before 从句；“投入到”= devote oneself to。

q58.sampleAnswer: Only by holding to our beliefs, and getting prepared for failure, can all the problems that seem unconquerable be solved at last.
references: Only by holding to our beliefs, and getting prepared for failure, can all the problems that seem unconquerable be solved at last.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “Only + 状语”放在句首时主句要部分倒装：can all the problems ... be solved；belief 的复数是 beliefs。

q59.sampleAnswer: While speeding through a yellow light might save you a little time, this behaviour is likely to result in a serious traffic accident.
references: While speeding through a yellow light might save you a little time, this behaviour is likely to result in a serious traffic accident.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: while 放在句首可表示“尽管”；“这种行为”= this behaviour；“引发”= result in。

q60.sampleAnswer: Protecting the environment is protecting us the human beings.
references: Protecting the environment is protecting us the human beings.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: 动名词 Protecting 作主语；“人类”= human beings。

q61.sampleAnswer: I believe in your ability to solve the problem.
references: I believe in your ability to solve the problem.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: believe in“相信……的价值、能力”；“解决问题的能力”= ability to solve the problem。

q62.sampleAnswer: There is a saying that well begun is half done.
references: There is a saying that well begun is half done.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 谚语 Well begun is half done.，begun 是 begin 的过去分词；“有句谚语”= There is a saying that...。

q63.sampleAnswer: April, when warm spring comes and flowers blossom, is the perfect time to enjoy the beauty of this southern town.
references: April, when warm spring comes and flowers blossom, is the perfect time to enjoy the beauty of this southern town.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: 用 when 引导的非限制性定语从句修饰 April；“领略……的美”= enjoy the beauty of...。

q64.sampleAnswer: The giant project of rebuilding the old/ancient town is temporarily suspended for lack of money, because it seems perfect on the surface but in fact needs to be fully discussed.
references: The giant project of rebuilding the old/ancient town is temporarily suspended for lack of money, because it seems perfect on the surface but in fact needs to be fully discussed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “由于缺乏资金”= for lack of money；“因为”用 because 引导原因状语从句；“被搁置”用被动语态 is suspended。

q65.sampleAnswer: What excited people all over the country was that China became the third country to softland an unmanned spacecraft on the surface of the moon.
references: What excited people all over the country was that China became the third country to softland an unmanned spacecraft on the surface of the moon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “令……兴奋的是”用 What 主语从句 + was that...；“成为”用过去式 became；the third country to do“第三个做……的国家”。
